name: Just-in-time access
short_description: An access model in which elevated permissions are granted only when needed and for a limited time, then expire automatically instead of remaining permanently assigned.

evidence.quote: The core concept is called just-in-time access, or GIT.
This requires just-in-time access and continuous monitoring.
